lines.en: “······And so, O noble and majestic Black Flame Dragon, master of the Black Cloud······ Damn it, why is this chant so long? Hey, is this really right?”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' nods.]
Cursing, Han Sooyoung dodged the spears of light flying toward her.
With a shhkk, blood burst from her shoulder.
[The constellation 'Master of the Ark' grins.]
Several nearby Valkyries burned away at once under the [Black Flames] she unleashed.
Startled by that wicked power, the Valkyries shouted.
[Kill her!]
[Absolute Evil must never be allowed to live!]
[Do not let her finish the incantation!]
Fending off the Valkyries swarming her, Han Sooyoung muttered.
“Isn't it basic etiquette to leave someone alone during their transformation?”
She bit her lip at the great army of Valkyries closing in.
Normally, dealing with lower-ranking Historical-grade incarnation bodies would have been nothing to her.
The problem was their skill.
[The nebula <Eden> is using 'Punishment Time'.]

[Punishment Time]. It was an ability very similar to the [Hour of Judgement] Jung Heewon used. A skill that greatly increased combat strength against Evil, though its buff did not match [Hour of Judgement].
And there were not one or two Valkyries receiving that skill's protection, but hundreds.
[Raphael, you've grown quite rusty!]
On one side of the battlefield, Asmodeus was laughing madly as he swept his claws through the air.
Demonic energy and divinity collided in midair, sending up clouds of explosive smoke. A piece of cloud floated above them.
Raphael was riding it.
[Don't get cocky. Keep that up and you'll get ur mouth wrecked again.]
[Ahahahaha! Your tongue is as sharp as ever!]
The tone was playful. The waves of Status it carried were anything but.
Han Sooyoung silently scowled.
No matter how she looked at it, that mad Demon King didn't seem to have a moment to spare to help her.
[The constellation 'Morning Star Goddess' considers joining the battle.]
[The constellation 'The One Who Faces God' frowns at the demonic energy of the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon'.]
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' anxiously glances elsewhere.]
And three great constellations on the 'Good' side still remained.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' tells you to stop worrying and keep chanting.]

“······The Dark of Darkness, the Legend of Legend, the great dragon among dragons, may the Black Flame Dragon's blessing be with this body―Damn it, you're doing this on purpose, aren't you? I can't do any more!”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' grins and says that is enough.]
The next instant, immense demonic energy exploded inside Han Sooyoung.
Feeling an unfathomable Status surge from deep within her, she closed her eyes. As it gradually consumed her mind, various things inside her were snapping.
The sound of her vague moral sense going numb: that she had to invalidate this battlefield, that <Kim Dokja’s Company> was neither Good nor Evil.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' begins 'Half-body Descent'!]
When she opened her eyes again, she was a different person.
[The mind of the incarnation 'Han Sooyoung' is contaminated by demonic energy!]
“Kuk, kuk. Kukuku······.”
Eyes boiling with violet demonic energy.
Covering half her face with one hand, Han Sooyoung wiped the blood from her cheek. Licking the fresh blood on the back of her hand, she asked.
“How laughable. Is this your limit?”
The Valkyries retreated, their shoulders trembling before that unknown aura.
Laughing wildly, Han Sooyoung cried.
“Kneel! This is the difference between your Status and mine······ Hey! Don't spout bullshit through my mouth!”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' says it cannot be helped if you want to use his true power.]
“No, if you're going to talk, at least say something decent―Come forth! My Dark Shadow Phoen······! No, not this!”
The chant was a mess, but it seemed to work. A vast shadow began spreading beneath her feet. It grew, shaking the whole earth, and soon came to resemble a dragon.
Han Sooyoung had seen this phenomenon a few times before.
In [Peace Land] and [Dark Castle], she had seen constellations use their power.
A constellation's shadow. Its darkness cast on the other side of starlight.
Before she knew it, Han Sooyoung was riding the back of a black dragon tens of meters tall.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' roars!]
A power that probability's restrictions had prevented him from using until now.
The Black Flame Dragon's shadow soared into the sky, carrying her.
With its black shadow blotting out the heavens, the dragon breathed fire toward the ground.
Kwooooooosh!
A shock wave sweeping away the entire battlefield. The fleeing Valkyries burned away.
An overwhelming force that rendered both [Punishment Time] and the nebula's blessing meaningless.
[U-uh, uaaaaaagh!]
As though recalling an unpleasant memory, the 'Master of the Ark' hugged his shoulders and trembled. Understandably. Every constellation of <Eden> feared the Apocalypse Dragon.
And the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' was one of the powerful candidates for the Final Dragon of the Book of Revelation.
This was the true power of the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon'.
Even as she suffered under the mounting pressure of probability, Han Sooyoung was filled with joy and exhilaration.
A good choice. Choosing the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' as her sponsor had been a very good choice.
“Hahahahaha! Die! Die! Die! Die! ······Fuck, stop it!”
Like someone suffering from schizophrenia, Han Sooyoung blurted out two different things at once.
[Your mind is contaminated by demonic energy.]
The Black Flame Dragon's power was strong, but it could not be overused. The more an incarnation used it, the more their ego became assimilated into the 'Black Flame Dragon'.
'A few years of this and I'll end up like Kim Namwoon.'
Regardless, the Black Flame Dragon's shadow was already sweeping away more than half the battlefield.
As though unable to stand by any longer, someone moved.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' reveals her Status!]
With an earthshaking roar, the Black Flame Dragon's breath was stopped for the first time. The essence of a pure white flame was cutting through the world's darkness.
[Flames of Retribution].
Uriel's Star Relic, forged from Hell's purest fire.
The Black Flame Dragon covering the sky laughed.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' says he has always wanted to settle this.]
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' hardens her expression.]
As the two constellations began their confrontation, blue sparks blanketed the surrounding space and time. Unable to withstand the clash of Status, Valkyries vomited blood and collapsed.
[The Most Ancient Good enjoys this local battle.]
[The Most Ancient Evil enjoys this local battle.]
The great forces of Good and Evil were choosing the two constellations as their representatives. And caught between them was Han Sooyoung, being scorched black by the sparks.
“Kukuku. Die! You stupid archan······ Hey! We can't do this!”
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' asks what is wrong.]
“You idiot! If we fight Uriel here, it's all over!”
Soot smeared across her face, Han Sooyoung yelled at the top of her lungs.
A moment ago, she had almost gotten caught up in the moment and fought, but if they actually did it, everything would fall apart.
“Hey, archangel! At least you get a grip! Are you really going to fight me?”
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' looks at you.]
An expression that seemed to say she had no choice.
Deep worry shadowed Uriel's eyes.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' looks troubled.]
“You don't want to fight either, right? I know. Let's stop here and end this. And while you're at it, persuade your friends too!”
At Han Sooyoung's words, Uriel's worry deepened.
Despite her expression, however, the [Hell Flames Ignition] she activated flew relentlessly toward Han Sooyoung.
But Han Sooyoung did not give up.
She believed Uriel had a reason for choosing to enter this battlefield.
[The Story 'Predictive Plagiarism' begins its storytelling.]
「Uriel must have known this was a trap to kill <Kim Dokja’s Company>. That's probably why she came herself.」
The problem was that she and the 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' had happened to enter Uriel's battlefield······.
Still, she, too, was part of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
Han Sooyoung decided to use the cheat code she had been saving.
“What do you think Kim Dokja will think of you if I die?”
Uriel's shoulders trembled faintly. Han Sooyoung struck another blow.
“I'm asking whether you can face Kim Dokja with a clear conscience after killing me.”
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' says that you and your sponsor are 'Evil.']
“Damn it! Who cares about Good or Evil! You made all that up however you pleased!”

[Flames of Retribution] grazed the base of the Black Flame Dragon's wing. Even as her surroundings shook, Han Sooyoung looked down at Uriel pleadingly. Uriel's sword movements had become far more hesitant.
A little more. Just one more push.
[The constellation 'Demon King of Salvation' is watching the battlefield.]
The next indirect message sent a chill through Han Sooyoung.
[The constellation 'Demon King of Salvation' looks at the 'Demon-like Judge of Fire.']
······Kim Dokja, you terrifying bastard.
Even with all that going on, he'd been watching this side too?
[The constellation 'Demon King of Salvation' looks at the 'Demon-like Judge of Fire.']
Kim Dokja said nothing.
No request for help, no plea. Just a gaze.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' stops moving.]
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' is thrown into confusion.]
Han Sooyoung cheered inwardly.
Conflicting feelings would be clashing inside Uriel now.
The desire to save <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
And the desire to win the 'Great War of Saints and Demons.'
Faint sparks rose around Uriel, one after another.
The Stories that made up Uriel were colliding.
Her favorite Story was clashing with the Story she had lived.
<Kim Dokja’s Company>, which she loved?
Or <Eden>, to which she belonged?
[Uriel! Why are you standing there like an idiot?]
Unable to watch any longer, the other constellations stepped forward.
[The constellation 'Morning Star Goddess' reveals her Status!]
[The constellation 'The One Who Faces God' reveals his Status!]
Han Sooyoung frowned as she gasped for breath.
[Your incarnation body has been severely damaged.]
She hadn't tried to persuade Uriel merely because she didn't want to fight her.

The side effects of [Half-body Descent] were already setting in. Her bones and joints were going numb, and she felt she might cough up blood at any moment. She forced it down only to avoid showing weakness to the constellations.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' is looking elsewhere.]
Camael stepped forward in place of the dazed Uriel and spoke.
[My companion seems to be struggling. We should put an end to this.]
[I had high expectations when I heard 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon'······ But you hardly live up to your modifier.]
As Vakarine's crystal staff shone with starlight, countless beams rained from the sky. Wherever the light touched, the Black Flame Dragon's shadow gradually broke apart.
[The constellation 'Abyssal Black Flame Dragon' lets out an angry roar!]
The breath unleashed by his shadow poured down over Vakarine's head. At the surge of dark ether, she screamed and retreated.
Camael took the attack in her place.
[That is nowhere near enough!]
Drawing his greatsword, Camael cut through the breath and advanced.
But.
“The Dark of Darkness! The Legend of Legend! The Fire of Crimson Flame!”
As Han Sooyoung began spouting nonsense, the Black Flame Dragon's breath abruptly intensified and drove Vakarine and Camael back.
Vakarine paled as her coat burst into flames.
[How humiliating! Because of such a ridiculous technique······!]
[Uriel! What are you doing? Get hold of yourself!]
Perhaps Camael's True Voice reached her. Uriel abruptly came to her senses. Wiping away the blood pouring from her, Han Sooyoung struggled to steady her blurring vision.
If Uriel attacked in earnest now, it would all be over.
Somehow, before that······.
[······Yes, you're right. This ■ of a war needs to end quickly.]
Then Uriel moved.
[The constellation 'Demon-like Judge of Fire' reveals her true form.]
The archangel's dazzling Status, suffusing the battlefield. All of Uriel's wings spread wide, and a crown set with red rubies shone above her streaming platinum-blond hair.
Emerald eyes that looked down upon the world.

Having released her true body, Uriel stepped forward, enduring a tremendous backlash of probability. Before that immense Status, Han Sooyoung nearly lost consciousness despite the Black Flame Dragon's protection.
That was the true form of the 'Demon-like Judge of Fire'.

The archangel of blazing fire who had spent her life cutting down tens of thousands of demons, killing Demon Kings and eradicating Evil. The instant she met those eyes, Han Sooyoung realized she was as good as dead.
Before that 'demon-like' being, any Evil would have to offer up its neck willingly.
'Sorry, Kim Dokja.'
The soaring [Flames of Retribution] cleaved the sky, and Han Sooyoung sensed an end.
[The Story 'Predictive Plagiarism' cannot envision what comes next.]
Then her vision turned white. A page upon which nothing existed.
But however long she waited, no pain came. Had she died before she could even feel it?
When she cautiously opened her eyes, an unexpected sight awaited her.
The [Flames of Retribution] that had unmistakably moved toward her had changed into rings, blazing brightly on the ground.
[Move and you're dead.]
More precisely, they were wrapped around Vakarine and Camael's torsos.
[My fire's pretty hot, you know? I'm not joking. Move and you'll really die.]
At the sudden turn of events, Vakarine asked in a dazed voice.
[Uriel······ Why on earth?]
[If you do this, the Scribe will······!]
At Camael's words, Uriel grumbled.
[■uck, I'll just take a little punishment. Is that what matters right now?]
[This will not end with disciplinary action! What you have just done―]
[Shut up! Let the damn Chaos Points rise a little!]
Only upon hearing her True Voice did Camael realize his companion was serious.
[What in the world are you······.]
Only then did Han Sooyoung understand why Uriel had revealed her true body's power.
To subdue an archangel of her own rank and a high-ranking constellation without killing them, she had no choice but to use her real power.
Uriel, suffering amid the backlash of probability. Faint demonic energy lingered around her black lace.
Corruption.
The harshest punishment bestowed upon her for refusing a sacred command.
Just as Han Sooyoung was about to say something, Uriel spoke first.
[There's no time to explain everything. Let's invalidate the local battle and finish this quickly!]
There was an urgency to her expression.
At that moment, something crossed Han Sooyoung's mind as well.
Even if Uriel had made up her mind, there was no need for such haste. If an archangel was willing to act at such great cost, there had to be a good reason. What could be making her hurry like this?
The answer was not difficult to find.
[My Heewon's in danger!]
“We can do it. We won't know until we fight.”
Three hours earlier, Jung Heewon had said those words.
“Demon Kings or whatever, tell them to come at us. We're not that weak anymore.”
The ones listening were reincarnators.
Those who had chosen 'Good' in the local battles they had survived so far. And those lucky enough to survive the battlefields <Kim Dokja’s Company> had invalidated.
People who had lost their own worlds.
[The 117th local battle begins!]
[Your camp is 'Good.']
“If I'd known it would be like this, I wouldn't have come out······”
“······Can't we go back to our original worlds?”
As a few people muttered in terror, the panic spread in an instant.
“H-how are we supposed to fight that!”
An 'Evil' warship was advancing. It was enormous. Without a doubt, it was a Story Weapon equipped with powerful functions.
Kieeeeeek―!
The wave carrying the ship forward was a vast army of seventh-grade demons called 'Dark Fighters.' Too many to count. There seemed to be tens of thousands of them.
It was a spectacle that could hardly be called a 'local battle.'
“Aaaaaaaaah―!”
Looking at the reincarnators' terrified eyes, Jung Heewon thought.
She could not demand courage of everyone.
Their fear was only natural.
People who had spent their whole lives confined to their own worlds, now being used by invaders from outside. To demand courage of such victims was itself an act of violence.
She wanted to tell them.
It was all right not to fight. She would try to handle things here herself, somehow.
“Everyone, take cover behind us.”
A man gave voice to what she was feeling.
“I'll stop them.”
It was Lee Hyunsung.
Her oldest companion, the man who had always stood at the very front to face <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s hardships.
“Can you stop them alone?”
“Of course I can't do it alone.”
His generous smile eased the tightness in her chest a little. Once, he had practically had a fit whenever their fingertips touched. They really had grown close.
“Let's each take a role. I'll take every attack. Heewon-ssi, you―”
“Attack, right? Like in Kaizenix.”
The two had fought together like this in the Kaizenix Archipelago too.
Memories of standing against waves of invading forces.
<Kim Dokja’s Company>'s strongest shield and sharpest sword.
A simple strategy, but the best way to use each other's strengths.
“Let's go.”
[The Story 'Sword and Shield' begins its storytelling.]
Lee Hyunsung charged first.
“Haaaaaaaah!”
True to his superstitious belief that a louder battle cry meant greater strength, Lee Hyunsung roared at the top of his lungs and met the oncoming wave.
[The incarnation Lee Hyunsung activates the stigma 'Steel Transformation Lv.10'!]
The steel carapace, now fully developed, covered his entire body. 'Dark Fighters' crashed into the brilliantly white steel skin, toppling and being crushed like bowling pins.
[The incarnation Lee Hyunsung activates the stigma 'Great Mountain Smash Lv.10'!]
His steel fist rose toward the sky, then struck the ground. The wave of Dark Fighters shook precariously, and the advancing ship slowed.
Without losing that momentum, Lee Hyunsung activated his final stigma.
[The incarnation Lee Hyunsung activates the stigma 'Great Mountain Push Lv.10'!]
At first, all that stigma could do was open a closed subway door.
Now it was holding back a ship the size of a battleship.
Tzzzzzzzzzt―!
His hands, reinforced by [Steel Transformation], turned black, and part of the steel shell (鋼殼) covering his skin peeled away. But Lee Hyunsung overcame the pain with an even louder cry.
“Haaaaaaaaah!”
He does not retreat, even amid the flood of sparks.
His rear foot dug deep into the ground, making him look like a small nail driven into it. That tiny nail was stopping a battleship.
The unpleasant scraping of steel against steel. And at the end of the roar, the battleship finally stopped.
“I-it stopped!”
“Lee Hyunsung-nim stopped the battleship!”
The reincarnators cheered at the unbelievable miracle.
But the fight was only beginning. The shield had done its part. Now it was the sword's turn.
Stepping onto Lee Hyunsung's shoulder, Jung Heewon leaped high into the air, landed on the ship's deck and swung her [Sword of Judgement].
[Gaaaaaagh!]
The combination of [Demon Slaying] and [Hell Flames Ignition]. Holding nothing back from the start, her attack slaughtered an unsuspecting Historical-grade constellation's entire incarnation body.
Scattering blue ghostly flames and pure white flashes, Jung Heewon was nobility itself.
[Some constellations enjoy the story of 'Sword and Shield.']
Claaaang!
But before long, her sword was stopped.
A hand covered in murky blackness. A being chuckled darkly, caught her sword, and flung her into the sky.
Stepping through the air, Jung Heewon twisted and landed back on the deck.
Constellations had already formed ranks there.
Rrrrrumble!
No, they were not constellations.
[Judging by that damned stigma, you must be the incarnation of that 'archangel'.]
[You must have known it was a trap······ How foolish. Walking to your death of your own accord.]
Beings wrapped head to toe in black demonic energy. Beings who occupied the darkness in the <Star Stream>'s sky.
Jung Heewon studied the five Demon Kings standing before her.
―This is a list of enemies you could try fighting, Heewon-ssi, and those you must never fight. Make sure you memorize their appearances.
She desperately recalled what Kim Dokja had told her.
The first to draw her gaze was a Demon King holding a flaming spear and a human head.
―You can take this one on. As you are now, Heewon-ssi, you should have no trouble if you activate [Hour of Judgement].
Amy, 'President of Flames,' ruler of the 58th Demon Realm.
―This one should be······ all right too. But if he suddenly raises his horns and charges, it's dangerous. Make sure you strike first.
Haagenti, 'Golden-horned Ox,' ruler of the 48th Demon Realm.
―From this one onward, it's dangerous. Fight him only when you're in good condition and can face him one on one.
Stolas, 'Silver-clawed Owl,' ruler of the 36th Demon Realm.
She could feel it from the Status they released.
Up to this point, she could still conceivably face them.
The problem was the two beings watching her from behind them.
First, a tall Demon King in red armor, looking at her as he limped.
―Once you get into the teens, frankly, your odds are poor. It would be different if Uriel came to your aid through Half-body Descent, but······.
Zepar, 'Demon King of Seduction and Infertility,' ruler of the 16th Demon Realm.
―And from this one onward, you must avoid them at all costs.
He need not have told her. The being observing the situation from the very end of the five Demon Kings.
That Demon King was someone she could never defeat as she was now.
Barbatos, 'Merciless Hunter Against the Will of Heavens,' ruler of the 8th Demon Realm.
A Western-style hat and a rifle. A Demon King with flowing blond hair smiled at her.
[The most delicious despair is 'impossible hope.']
Jung Heewon gripped her blade firmly, her fighting spirit burning.
She had fought Demon Kings once before.
Back then, it had been hard for her to use her full strength······ What about now?
[Preparing to activate the exclusive skill 'Hour of Judgement'!]
Her attribute was 'Judge of Evil.'
The power used by an archangel, leader of the Valkyries who had fought in the Great War of Saints and Demons long ago.
However powerful her opponent, she would not lose so long as that being was 'Evil.'
But.
[A majority of Absolute Good-aligned constellations have opposed the skill's activation.]
[Skill activation has been canceled.]
As though he knew what had happened to her, Barbatos smiled.
[How foolish, Uriel's incarnation. Do you still not understand your situation?]
Kim Dokja had said these 'local battles' were traps.
That we had to join the battle here, even knowing it was a trap.
[Angels are particularly fond of the concept of a 'sacrificial lamb.' This time, it seems to be you.]
<Eden>'s goal was victory in the Great War of Saints and Demons.
And to achieve it, <Kim Dokja’s Company> had to cease to exist. Whether Jung Heewon was 'Good' or 'Evil,' she was merely something they had to eliminate.
She knew that too. Yet it still did not feel real.
······Whatever the other angels might do, had even Uriel betrayed me?
[I will give you an easy death.]
She heard Barbatos load his rifle.
At the same instant that a chill ran down her neck, Jung Heewon threw herself off the ship.
Kwoooooosh!
The bullet fired toward the sky tore through space and time, punching a black hole in the air.
Her sword hand trembled. She had just been about to fight a monster like that.
―Never fight a top-ten Demon King one on one. Run, no matter what. And wait for the others. You must.
Normally, she would have argued with him.
Not now.
“Hyunsung-ssi!”
Below the bow, Lee Hyunsung had been beating Dark Fighters to death. He looked up at her. A single exchange of glances was enough for him to understand the battlefield's situation.
The Demon Kings' mocking voices reached them.
[Hahahahaha! A wise choice.]
[The battlefield is vast. But how far can you run?]
A storm of demonic energy poured from the sky.
The sword and shield ran.
They could not fight an enemy they were no match for. Nor could they die here.
“Dokja-ssi and Yoo Joonghyuk-ssi will come. We just need to hold out until then.”
Jung Heewon nodded. However strong the enemy, they could win once everyone was together. They had survived worse battlefields. <Kim Dokja’s Company> would not fall here.
Taking care of wounded reincarnators and crushing the Dark Fighters charging at them, the two continued to pull back.
[Your sponsor's influence is weakening.]

To make matters worse, even Uriel's protection was fading. An ugly thought arose, but Jung Heewon shook her head. Uriel was probably fighting in another local battle too. Uriel would never betray her.
A Demon King's savage True Voice swept across the battlefield.
[Out of the way, trash.]
Reincarnators who had missed their chance to flee were being slaughtered everywhere.
Those who charged courageously were the first to lose their heads. Those who backed away in fear had their hearts pierced.
But some endured the Demon Kings' power and fought back.
[Oh, a Sword Master? You fight rather well.]
Someone was holding back Haagenti's golden horns.
Ether Blade flowing along the sword's blade.
Jung Heewon knew the old man wielding it.
Kyle Berthe.
He was the senior knight of the royal guard who had attended her in the Kaizenix Archipelago.
「Captain-nim, it is an honor to serve you.」
「In truth, I am too old to venture into the outside world.」
「But I hope this meager strength will be of some small help there as well.」
Kyle fought well. He blocked Haagenti's horns several times, and even left a small scratch on the ox's forearm.
But that was as far as he got.
The Sword Master's sword broke, and his knees buckled.
It had never been an enemy an elderly Sword Master could face.
Seized by the throat, Kyle was lifted into the air like a toy.
[The character 'Erich Striker' is shaken.]
Within Jung Heewon, Erich's emotions stirred.
At this rate, Kyle would die.
Jung Heewon's thoughts moved slowly. The names of <Kim Dokja’s Company> passed through her mind.
The first to come to her was Yoo Joonghyuk.
「“Even if they die, reincarnators come back to life anyway.”」

Yoo Joonghyuk would not have saved Kyle. This 'Reincarnation Island' did not allow death. Even if they lost their memories and became someone else, their souls survived. He would have let Kyle die for a greater purpose.
Kim Dokja came to mind next.
「We have to save him. But if you do that, you'll die, Heewon-ssi.」
Even while saying the right thing, Kim Dokja would have turned away from Kyle out of concern for her life.
「What's there to think about? Use him to kill that Demon King.」
That was what Han Sooyoung would have said.
She had never been particularly interested in saving lives.
To turn the worst situation to the greatest advantage, Han Sooyoung would have gone straight for the Demon King's throat.
And the dying Kyle's lips were saying.
'Run.'
But his eyes were saying this.
「Please······ save me.」
“Heewon-ssi.”
Lee Hyunsung's voice reached her.
Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung were more alike than any other two members of <Kim Dokja’s Company>.
Their personalities and flexibility differed, but in at least one situation, they always made the same choice.
[Activating the exclusive skill 'Hell Flames Ignition Lv.10'!]
There was no need to hesitate.
Because they, too, had been saved that way.
For an instant, their eyes met.
「“You all remember how to fight the Demon King.”」
They shared the same pain, and had lived with the same wounds.
They had lost a beloved companion before their eyes.
「“Now, let's begin the final scenario.”」
Again and again, they had failed to save that companion.
That was why they could never turn away from someone dying in front of them.
The lives they had lived had made them that way.
“Go!”
Jung Heewon sprang lightly onto Lee Hyunsung's palm, and he hurled her with all his strength.
Shot forward like a ray of light, she crossed the battlefield. As [Hell Flames Ignition] surged in a brilliant arc, Haagenti groaned.
Slicing away part of his hide to extinguish the fire, Haagenti answered with a fierce bellow.
[So that's where you were hiding!]
Without hesitation, he charged, kicking up a cloud of dust.
“Gaaaaaah!”
While Lee Hyunsung caught Haagenti's horns and held him back, Jung Heewon shook the fallen Kyle.
“Kyle! Wake up! Kyle!”
As though she had become Erich Striker again, she called his name desperately. Bringing a hand beneath his nose, she found, thankfully, that he was still breathing.
「“Once more, the scenarios······.”」
People who had come this far after listening to her, to <Kim Dokja’s Company>. People who had followed her to find their own stories.
She could never let them die here.
“I'll take him.”
One of the royal guard knights came up just then and hoisted Kyle onto their back.
“Please.”
“Leave it to me.”
The knight nodded solemnly in reply and immediately ran toward the rear. Jung Heewon gripped her sword again to help Lee Hyunsung. And at that moment.
A terrible premonition ran through her whole body.
A premonition she had felt only a handful of times before.
When she lost Kim Dokja in [Dark Castle]. When she lost him again in the [73rd Demon Realm]. And······.
